full_prompt_en: A square cinematic digital painting shows two small silhouettes approaching a glowing archway through a dark misty street. The narrow street is framed by almost black building masses on both sides, with their upper stories disappearing into green-blue fog. A pale cyan opening in the clouded sky sits high at the center, separated from the lower orange light by dark facades and a faint cross-street structure. Thin posts and wires jut from the right-hand wall, while a few weak red lamps punctuate the left and middle distance. At the far end, a large rounded arch shines with intense orange and amber light. Its sides are partly obscured by haze, so the bright opening feels deep and uncertain rather than crisp. Two human figures stand in the lower center, walking away from the viewer toward the arch. One is slightly taller; both are rendered as dark coats and heads with no readable facial features. Indistinct vehicle shapes and low debris line the sides of the road near them. The wet ground reflects narrow muted streaks of the warm glow, but most of the foreground remains black-green. Heavy fog and smoke simplify the architecture into layered slabs, with an occasional edge catching amber. Light comes primarily from beyond the arch, backlighting the two figures and spreading a reddish haze into the lower street. Cool diffuse glow from above faintly reveals the upper walls without overcoming the darkness. Fine grain, brushed atmospheric texture, and irregular shadow edges keep the scene tactile. There is no readable signage. The overall composition is symmetrical in its central destination yet irregular at the edges, using a small pair of figures and a concentrated warm opening to create suspense within an immense cool shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影式数字绘画呈现两名小小剪影，沿昏暗雾街走向发光拱门。狭窄街道两侧由几乎黑色的建筑体块围合，高层消失进青蓝色雾中。上部中央的云天开出一块淡青亮处，与下方橙光之间隔着深色立面和朦胧的横街结构。右侧墙面伸出细杆与电线，几盏微弱红灯点在左侧和中景。街道尽端，一道巨大的圆顶拱门发出强烈橙色和琥珀光。两边被雾部分遮住，使发亮开口显得幽深不定，而非边界锐利。两个人影位于下部中央，背对观者向拱门走去。一人稍高；两人都只呈深色外套和头部形状，没有可辨的面孔。模糊车形与低矮杂物排在他们附近的道路两侧。湿地面映着几道狭窄而压低的暖光，但前景大部仍是黑绿色。厚雾与烟把建筑简化成层叠板块，仅偶有边缘接到琥珀光。主要光源来自拱门后方，使两人逆光，并把红色雾气散进街道下部。上方冷调漫光微微显出高墙，却无法驱散黑暗。细颗粒、刷过的氛围肌理与不规则影边保留画面触感。没有可读标牌。整体构图以中央目标建立对称，却在边缘保持不规则，借一对小人物与集中的暖光开口在巨大冷影中制造悬念。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic digital painting builds vast dark space from blue-green, charcoal, and nearly black tonal layers. A single concentrated amber-orange glow pushes through haze, giving the warmest area strong depth and making small dark accents legible as silhouettes. Broad architectural masses dissolve into fog rather than ending in uniformly sharp outlines. Cool light from above reveals only a few high planes, while a warmer lower source catches edges and produces sparse wet reflections. Grain, smoke-like brushwork, and scumbled transitions soften the boundaries between forms. The composition uses a central luminous opening and dark flanking masses, with much of the foreground intentionally low in detail. Perspective is suggested by receding values and scale more than precise lines. Small isolated red lights add secondary rhythm without competing with the main glow. The overall effect is ominous and immersive, relying on restrained visibility, strong value control, and warm-cool separation.
style_prompt_zh: 电影式数字绘画用蓝绿、炭色和近黑色明度层建立巨大暗空间。一处集中的琥珀橙光穿透雾气，使最暖区域带强烈纵深，并让细小深色重音成为可辨剪影。宽阔体块消融入雾，而非处处以同样锐利的轮廓收尾。上方冷光只揭示少量高处平面，较暖的低位光抓住边缘并在湿面留下稀疏倒影。颗粒、烟雾般笔触和擦涂过渡柔化形体间边界。构图以中央发光开口和两侧深色体块组织，大部分前景有意少细节。透视主要由退远的明度和尺度暗示，而非精确线条。孤立小红灯提供次要节奏，却不争夺主光。整体效果不祥而沉浸，依赖克制的可见度、强明度控制和冷暖分离。
theme_en: Two silhouettes approach a glowing arch through a dark misty street
theme_zh: 两个人影沿昏暗雾街走向发光拱门
name: Guillem H. Pongiluppi
